narrative.overview:
Canaster should feel like a dependable work surface carried between office, site, and shared screen: compact, readable, sturdy, and ready for interruption. The current visual system is a restrained product interface with a dark canvas-first default, a light operational fallback, floating utility chrome, and precise blue selection feedback.

The system is not decorative. Panels float because they must stay available over the canvas; blur is an overlay legibility tool, not a visual theme. Color is sparse and functional: blue identifies selection and primary action, green marks successful or data-oriented state, amber marks system or pending state, and red is reserved for failure.
keyCharacteristics: Functional color only; no ornamental accents.
Clear focus, selection, sync, and disabled states.
Direct manipulation vocabulary for non-technical professionals.

rules.name: The State Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Blue, green, amber, gold, and red are state and type colors. Never use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Canvas Leads Rule
rules.body: The canvas background and grid establish the product atmosphere; panels must support the work surface, not compete with it.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: Canaster is a working tool, not a landing page. Do not introduce clamp-sized display headings, decorative type, or display fonts in app chrome.

rules.name: The Overlay Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur and shadows are allowed only for UI that must float above the canvas: toolbars, status, panels, previews, and blocking confirmation.

rules.name: The Stroke Beats Glow Rule
rules.body: Selection is a blue stroke and focus outline first. Shadows may support state, but must not become the state indicator.

dos: Do keep the canvas as the primary surface and let chrome float only where the user needs immediate control.
Do use Working Blue for selection, focus, and active affordances only.
Do preserve the 6px control radius and 8px panel/node radius unless a new component has a strong usability reason.
Do keep toolbar controls stable at 32px desktop and 28px mobile so icons never shift layout.
Do make sync, selection, disabled, loading, and error states visible through text, shape, icon, or stroke, not color alone.
Do use practical labels for non-technical professionals; object names should sound like work items, not graph/database primitives.
donts: Don't make this feel like a developer diagramming tool, a BI dashboard, a generic whiteboard, or a novelty mind-map app.
Don't use terminal aesthetics, engineering jargon, dense admin-console chrome, overplayful collaboration cues, ornamental gradients, decorative canvas flourishes, or graph/database assumptions.
Don't introduce gradient text, decorative bokeh/orbs, diagonal stripe backgrounds, or oversized marketing typography.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px on cards, nodes, callouts, or alerts. Canvas node accent marks must remain small internal markers.
Don't pair a 1px decorative border with a wide soft shadow on generic cards. Shadows are for floating chrome, nodes, overlays, and blocking panels.
Don't use modal dialogs as the first solution for routine actions. Prefer inline panel states and direct manipulation unless the action blocks or destroys work.

components.name: Toolbar Icon Button
components.description: Compact square icon action used in the topbar.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Fit view"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3M16 3h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v3M8 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-3M16 21h3a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #c6ced8; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-icon-button:hover { color: #eef2f6; background: rgba(90, 167, 255, 0.16); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5aa7ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-button:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: default; }

components.name: Floating Toolbar Group
components.description: Functional overlay shell for related canvas controls.
components.css: .ds-toolbar-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 150, 165, 0.22); border-radius: 8px; color: #eef2f6; background: rgba(24, 29, 37, 0.84); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); } .ds-mini-button { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #c6ced8; background: transparent; } .ds-mini-button:hover { color: #eef2f6; background: rgba(90, 167, 255, 0.16); } .ds-toolbar-readout { min-width: 48px; text-align: center; color: #c6ced8; font: 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Compact Field
components.description: Document/auth field used inside the floating topbar.
components.css: .ds-compact-field { width: 142px; height: 30px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 150, 165, 0.22); border-radius: 6px; color: #c6ced8; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); font: 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-compact-field:focus { border-color: #5aa7ff; } .ds-compact-field::placeholder { color: #8b96a5; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Bottom-left live readout for selection, pointer mode, render count, interaction, and canvas path.
components.html: No selectionMove over canvasDrawn 5/5IdleCanvas root
components.css: .ds-statusbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 92px 70px 112px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: min(520px, calc(100% - 28px)); height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 150, 165, 0.22); border-radius: 8px; color: #8b96a5; background: rgba(24, 29, 37, 0.84); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); font: 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-statusbar span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Node Access Row
components.description: Selectable row inside the node access panel.
components.html: x -112, y -64, size 224x112
components.css: .ds-node-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 30px; gap: 4px 6px; width: 290px; } .ds-node-select, .ds-node-toggle { height: 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 150, 165, 0.22); border-radius: 6px; color: #c6ced8; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); cursor: pointer; } .ds-node-select { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 8px; font: 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-node-select span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-node-select span:last-child, .ds-node-meta { color: #8b96a5; font: 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-node-select[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #5aa7ff; color: #eef2f6; background: rgba(90, 167, 255, 0.16); } .ds-node-toggle { font: 700 16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-node-meta { grid-column: 1 / -1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-confirmation { width: min(360px, calc(100% - 32px)); padding: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 150, 165, 0.28); border-radius: 8px; color: #eef2f6; background: rgba(24, 29, 37, 0.96); box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-confirmation h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-confirmation p { margin: 0 0 14px; color: #8b96a5; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.38; } .ds-confirmation div { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-confirmation button { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 150, 165, 0.24); border-radius: 6px; color: #c6ced8; background: rgba(24, 29, 37, 0.84); cursor: pointer; } .ds-confirmation button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5aa7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }
